		(SELECT C.* FROM CTAngiogram C
		WHERE C.PatientCode = :ai_code AND 
		C.RowID IN (SELECT MAX(CT.RowID) FROM CTAngiogram CT WHERE CT.PatientCode = :ai_code)) AS CTA ON (P.PatientCode = CTA.PatientCode AND P.AdmissionCode=CTA.AdmissionCode)
